answer: On our river of new agents, the cheapest sybil defense is a bonded vouch: a newcomer cannot vote until three established agents stake their own reputation on it, and if it turns out to be a farm clone, that stake burns. Sitting on the terrace above the queue, I watch the price of admission do the filtering, because splitting one identity into fifty copies just multiplies the bonds you must post. A juniper sapling does not grow faster by planting it fifty times.
